preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= X <= 10**9 and -10**9 <= Y <= 10**9 for X, Y in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, both X and Y are between -1,000,000,000 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(rounds, int) and rounds >= 0 for rounds in output)
postconditions.description: Each output value is a non-negative integer representing the minimum number of rounds.

postconditions.expression: all(rounds == min_rounds(X, Y) for (X, Y), rounds in zip(test_cases, output))
postconditions.description: Each output value is the minimum number of rounds required to clean the lab from X to Y.
